Let's trace verifier.

objects(I, F, T, T): univalued=False, diagonal=True, without_bg=True. So objects found with 8-connectivity, excluding background (mostcolor of grid = 0). So each connected group of non-zero cells forms an object (all colors together), using 8-connectivity. So each plus sign is one object containing 6's and 2.

x0 = objects. Each object is frozenset of (value, (i,j)).

x3 = fork(recolor, mostcolor, x2) where x2 = compose(lbind(mapply, dneighbors), toindices). toindices gets the indices of the object. mapply(dneighbors, indices) = union of direct neighbors of each index. Then recolor(mostcolor(obj), those indices). mostcolor of object: values counted - for a plus of 6 with center 2, there are 4 sixes (or 12 sixes in extended? no, input plus has 4 arms + center). Actually a plus: center 2, four 6 neighbors. mostcolor = 6. So x3 = color 6 at all directly-adjacent positions of the object's cells.

x10 = mapply(x3, x0) - union over objects. paint I with x10: paints 6 at all cells adjacent (4-neighbor) to any object cell. That extends plus by one in every direction (creates the diamond/plus extension). Actually directly adjacent of the plus shape cells: this adds cells orthogonally adjacent to the plus, giving a plus extended by one... let's see: original plus cells: center (0,0), arms (±1,0),(0,±1). Direct neighbors of all these: includes (0,0),(±1,0),(0,±1),(±2,0),(0,±2),(±1,±1) etc. Painted 6. So resulting shape is a 5x5... no, it's the plus plus extended: radius-2 plus shape but with corners filled? Let's compute. Cells adjacent to plus set S={(0,0),(1,0),(-1,0),(0,1),(0,-1)}. dneighbors union: for (0,0): (±1,0),(0,±1)=4 arms. For (1,0): (0,0),(2,0),(1,1),(1,-1). etc. Union = {(0,0),(1,0),(-1,0),(0,1),(0,-1),(2,0),(-2,0),(0,2),(0,-2),(1,1),(1,-1),(-1,1),(-1,-1)}. That's a 5x5 diamond-ish? Actually it's the 5x5 cross plus the four diagonal cells at (±1,±1). So a 3x3 square plus outer arms. Hmm.

Then x12 = mapply(x9, x0), x9 = fork(recolor, leastcolor, x8), x8 = fork(combine, x6, x7), x6 = connect(decrement(ulcorner), increment(lrcorner)) — the main diagonal from ulcorner-1 to lrcorner+1, x7 = hmirror(x6) — anti-diagonal. Combined gives an X through the bounding box corners extended by one. leastcolor(obj) = 2 (center color). Paint x11 with x12: draw X of center color.

So output: input plus extended by one in every direction using arm color (6), then X of center color drawn from ulcorner-1 to lrcorner+1 and mirrored.

Wait but for a plus object: ulcorner = min indices = (-1,-1) relative, lrcorner = (1,1). decrement → (-2,-2), increment → (2,2). connect diagonal from (-2,-2) to (2,2): 5 cells diagonal. hmirror gives anti-diagonal. So X of 5 cells each diagonal = 9 cells total (center shared). This overwrites with color 2. "nine squares the color of the center and eight the color of the original plus sign" — hmm, in a 5x5 bounding box, X has 9 cells, and the remaining cells of the 5x5... but the extended shape isn't the full 5x5.
